mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 4.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days when the signal is active.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low-FEDFUNDS periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
